ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Fraud: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the details of the $11M Medicaid fraud scheme, including entities involved and potential connections to other fraud cases.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and explore connections to other entities
questions: What are the connections to other fraud cases?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger pattern of fraud in Minnesota's healthcare system, potentially involving multiple entities and large sums of money.

ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme: A Closer Look
